subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Read the story and find the space objects in it.
Correct false sentences about the story.
Think about what to do when something goes wrong.

tf.s: The children make a model of the solar system for the Science Fair.
tf.why: Their first project is a model of the solar system.

tf.s: There are three challenges for the Science Fair.
tf.why: There are two challenges for the Science Fair.
Bo breaks the model, so the children can't finish it.

tf.s: The Moon is about a thousand kilometres from the Earth.
tf.why: The Moon is about 380,000 kilometres from the Earth.
In space, things float because they are weightless.

tf.s: In space, water stays in the glass when you brush your teeth.
The children finish their first project.
tf.why: The model breaks, so they don't finish it.

tf.s: The children use a bottle of water, a straw, toothpaste and a toothbrush in their final project.
tf.why: These things show how to brush your teeth in space.

tf.s: When something doesn't go well, you should try again and think about why.
When something goes wrong, it is best to stop and never try again.
tf.why: It is better to try again later and think about what happened.

boxes.q: What are the children making for the Science Fair at first?
o: a model of the solar system
boxes.why: Their first project is a model of the solar system.
Bo breaks the model in the story.

boxes.q: How many projects do the children make?

boxes.why: When things are weightless, they float.

boxes.q: Which word is in the story?
boxes.why: The children use a toothbrush in their project.

boxes.q: The children's first project is a ______ of the solar system.
boxes.why: They make a model of the solar system.
After "will" we use the base verb.

boxes.q: In space, what happens to water?
boxes.why: In space, water is weightless and floats away.

boxes.q: Do the children finish their first project?
boxes.why: The model breaks, so they don't finish it.

boxes.q: What should you do when something doesn't go well?
boxes.why: Trying again helps you do better.

hunt.q: Good thing to do after a mistake

mcq.q: What is the Science Fair challenge in the story about?
mcq.why: The story is about space and the solar system.

mcq.q: What happens to the first model?
Which space object is in the story?
mcq.why: The children talk about the Moon and the solar system.

mcq.q: Which things do the children use in their final project?
o: a bottle of water, a straw, toothpaste and a toothbrush
a rocket, a comet and a star
a book, a pen and a bag
mcq.why: These things show how to brush your teeth in space.

mcq.q: Correct the sentence: There are three challenges for the Science Fair.
o: There are two challenges for the Science Fair.
There are four challenges for the Science Fair.
There is no challenge for the Science Fair.

mcq.q: Your model breaks. What is the best thing to do?
o: Think about why it broke and try again.
mcq.why: Trying again and learning from mistakes is a good value.

mcq.q: How can an astronaut sleep in space without floating away?
o: in a sleeping bag tied to the wall
in a chair by the window
mcq.why: Things float in space, so the bed must be tied down.

mcq.q: Why is brushing your teeth in space different?
o: Everything is weightless and water floats away.
There is no toothpaste in space.
It is very cold in space.
mcq.why: Water floats away when things are weightless.

mcq.q: Why do the children need a straw in their final project?
o: Water floats in space, so a straw helps you drink it.
A straw is a space object.
A straw makes the model stronger.
mcq.why: A straw helps astronauts control the water.

mcq.q: What does the story teach us?
o: When something goes wrong, try again.
mcq.why: The children didn't give up and made a new project.
